patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — 6sense and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than 6sense's shape. Workflow advantage: 6sense leans lead-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — 6sense and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote ; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: 6sense (mid-market, enterprise) vs Snov.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: 6sense-leaning lead-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach.
- Researched limits: 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead; Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid 6sense if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
